column1: # Custom partition table for epd397 — 16MB layout (no OTA).
# The Waveshare ESP32-S3-ePaper-3.97 is an N16R8 (16MB flash). We drop the
# dual-app OTA scheme; a full re-flash over USB is always available and simpler
# than maintaining two app slots. `otadata` is kept (Arduino-ESP32 references it
# during boot) but never points anywhere meaningful with a single app0 slot.
# `rcdata` keeps its own 128KB NVS partition — nvs.cpp opens the "rcpaper"
# blob has room (the default nvs is 20KB total).
